reason: Pay-when-happy sounds good, but I get these DMs every month and this one is a bloke in Kuwait with no UK clients and a made-up plumber demo. I want it done for me and not to babysit it, and I can't tell yet if he'll still be answering when something breaks at 9am on a Saturday.
objection: Who actually looks after it once it's live, from another time zone, with nobody local I can ring? And the 'honest public review' bit makes me think the real price is me being his guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: A 10-minute video call where he shows me a site he's already mocked up for my business, plus one UK owner I can actually message who says he delivered.
